reviewer.name: Independent source chronology reviewer Jinshu 090 (潘京–丁紹 tranche)

summary: Partial review s0213–s0276 (潘京, 范晷/廣/稚, 丁紹). Supported undated discourse, explicit ages, undated deaths, and retrospective 別有傳; blocked Western interval/bound imports on 光武時, 元康中, 元帝承制, 討破汲桑/暴疾而卒, 懷帝. Grouped recurring defects for owner patch.
